name: Drupal Path in JS
description: Module for adding a drupal path or route control in javascript.
project_description: Drupal Path in JS exposes Drupal's server-side route/URL generation to client-side JavaScript. It registers two AJAX endpoints and attaches a small library that defines two global helpers: Drupal.alias(route, params, options) returns a named route's generated (aliased) URL, and Drupal.path(route, params, options) returns its internal system path. This lets front-end code resolve a URL from a route machine name at runtime instead of hard-coding paths, so AJAX callbacks and links keep working when aliases or paths change. The module ships no settings UI, no configuration objects, and has no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
